name: Mondrian Mexico City Condesa

address.street: Aguascalientes 156 Hipodromo Condesa Cuauhtemoc Mexico City

insider_take: This design-forward hotel sits in the heart of Condesa, Mexico City's most vibrant neighborhood where Art Deco architecture meets modern cool.
whats_special: The Mondrian showcases stunning contemporary Mexican design with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking tree-lined streets. Located in Condesa, the area was built on a former hippodrome and features some of Mexico City's best preserved Art Deco buildings from the 1930s. The neighborhood is known as the "SoHo of Mexico City" for its creative energy and walkable streets.
pro_tip: Take a morning stroll through nearby Parque México - this circular park was designed around the original horse racing track and offers perfect people-watching with your coffee.
dont_miss: Explore the famous Mercado Medellín just minutes away, Mexico City's largest international market where you can find authentic ingredients from across Latin America, plus some of the city's best street tacos right outside its entrance.
pros: Prime location in trendy Condesa neighborhood with walkable restaurants and nightlife
Sophisticated contemporary design with Mondrian's signature modern aesthetic
Rooftop bar and restaurant with panoramic Mexico City skyline views
Boutique luxury experience with personalized service and intimate atmosphere
cons: Urban setting may lack traditional Mexican resort amenities like pools or spas
Premium pricing reflects luxury boutique positioning
